title: pilosella fennica subsp. fulvescens
intro: Pilosella fennica subsp. fulvescens, commonly known as Alpine Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella fennica subsp. fulvescens include analgesic, antiarthritic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic applications, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
